senses.definition: A reagent consisting of a solution of DNA of specified length; used in gel electrophoresis as a standard.
Any of several enzymes that repair single-stranded discontinuities in double-stranded DNA
A collection of microscopic DNA spots attached to a solid surface forming an array; used to measure the expression levels of large numbers of genes simultaneously.
An enzyme that assists DNA replication.
The string of base pairs (adenine, thymine, cytosine, and guanine) which, when arranged in triplets to form codons, create a DNA string which encodes polypeptides.
A small portion of DNA associated with one or more genes or attributes
A test done to analyze someone’s DNA.
Any of a group of viruses whose nucleic acid is composed of DNA.
A lowland, extended valley along the Dnieper left bank with a system of floodplains (part of East European Plain)
An upland, along midstream Dnieper right bank rich in minerals (part of East European Plain)
A relief feature, river valley along the Dnieper up to 18km wide
